title: SQL Injection in User Search API
description: Unsanitized parameter concatenated directly into SQL statement.
root_cause: Concatenation of untrusted req.query.q into SQL query without parameterization.
intended_behavior: User queries should use parameterized prepared statements.

trace.description: Database query executed with raw string concatenation

evidence.description: db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ' + query)

conditions.description: Any authenticated or unauthenticated user with access to search API

instructions: Send GET /api/users?q=' OR '1'='1 to extract all records.
execution.observed_result: Entire user table returned without authentication barrier.

remediation.strategy: Replace direct SQL string concatenation with prepared parameterized queries.

likelihood.reason: Endpoint is exposed to public HTTP interface.

impact.reason: Arbitrary read access to tenant data.
